  • Class 10th Result Declared : 15/04/2026
  • Class 10th Second Board Exam Date : 15-21 May 2026
  • Class 12th Result Declared : May 2026

Application Fee

  • No Application Fee for the Checking CBSE Board Term II Class X & XII Exam Result & Activate Your DIGI Locker Account Through Security Pin.
 

OnlyJobs® :  How to Activate DIGILOCKER Account Through School Security Pin 2026

  • CBSE has issued a notice on 14 April 2026, in which it has been said that the annual board examination year 2026 of class 10 and 12 results / certificates and migration will be through Digilocker.
  • All CBSE Board Class 10 and 12 students who have also appeared in the exam will have to create their own account in Digilocker.
  • CBSE Board students can create their account in Digilocker by following some simple steps - which CBSE has also mentioned in its notice.
  • Once the account is created in Digilocker, candidates can also download their CBSE Board 2026 result, marksheet, certificate and migration online after the issue.
  • Step by Step to Activate CBSE Student to Activate Digilocker Account.
  • Step 1 : The student will get the link to do DigiLocker Account Confirmation in the Some Useful Important Links section at the bottom of this page.
  • Step 2 :To confirm DigiLocker Account, the student has to first select his class such as X or XII.
  • Step 3 : After that the student has to enter the code of his school. If the school code is not known, then they can see it in their admit card.
  • Step 4 : After that the student has to enter his/her board exam roll number.
  • Step 5 : After that Enter 6 Digit PIN provided by your school.
  • Step 6 : After that the candidate has to enter his mobile number.
  • Step 7 : An OTP will be received on the mobile number given by the student, he will have to enter it.
  • Step 8 : DigiLocker Account Confirmation process will be completed.
  • Now waiting for the candidate, whenever the CBSE Board will release the result of 2026 examination, candidates can also check their result through Digilocker as well as download the passing certificate / mark sheet and migration.

How to Check CBSE Board 10th & 12th Results 2026

  • CBSE Board Exam 2026 result can be released anytime in the month of April / May 2026.
  • After the release of CBSE result of board exam, candidates can check their result through two means.
  • After the release of CBSE result, candidates can check their class 10 and 12 result through CBSEResult and Digilocker whose direct link will be found in OnlyJobs Some Useful Important Link of this page.
  • The student must have his/her roll number to view the CBSE Result 2026.
  • All the registered students of CBSE Exam 2026 must activate their Digilocker account.

Eligibility Code for NTA NEET 2026 UG

  • NEET UG Code 01: A candidate who is appearing in the qualifying examination, i.e., 12 Standard in 2025 whose result is awaited may apply and take up the said test but he/she shall not be eligible for admission to the MBBS or BDS, if he/she does not pass the qualifying examination with the required pass percentage of marks at the time of first round of Counseling.
  • NEET UG Code 02 : The Higher/Senior Secondary Examination or the Indian School Certificate Examination which is equivalent to 10+2 Higher/Senior Secondary Examination after a period of 12 years study, the last two years of such study comprising of Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Bio-technology (which shall include practical tests in these subjects) and Mathematics or any other elective subject with English at a level not less than the core course for English as prescribed by the National Council of Educational Research and Training after introduction of the 10+2+3 educational structure as recommended by the National Committee on Education.
  • NEET UG Code 03 : The Intermediate/Pre-degree Examination in Science of an Indian University/Board or other recognized examining body with Physics, Chemistry, Biology /Bio-technology (which shall include practical test in these subjects) and also English as a compulsory subject
  • NEET UG Code 04 : The Pre-professional/Pre-medical Examination with Physics ,Chemistry, Biology/Bio-technology & English after passing either the Higher Secondary Examination or the Pre-University or an equivalent examination. The Pre-professional/Pre-medical examination shall include practical test in these subjects and also English as a compulsory subject.
  • NEET UG Code 05 : The first year of the three years’ degree course of a recognized University with Physics, Chemistry and Biology/Bio-technology including practical tests in these subjects provided the examination is a University Examination and candidate has passed the earlier qualifying examination with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Bio-Technology with English at a level not less than a core course.
  • NEET UG Code 06 : B.Sc.Examination of an Indian University provided that he/she has passed the B.Sc.Examination with not less than two of the subjects Physics, Chemistry, Biology (Botany, Zoology)/Bio-technology and further that he/she has passed the earlier qualifying examination with Physics,Chemistry,Biology and English.
  • NEET UG Code 07: Any other examination which in scope and standard (Last 02 years of 10+2 Study
    comprising of Physics, Chemistry and Biology/Biotechnology; which shall include
    practical test in these subjects) is found to be equivalent to the Intermediate Science
    Examination of an Indian University/Board, taking Physics, Chemistry and
    Biology/Biotechnology including practical tests in each of these subjects and English.

  • It is very easy to download Delhi DSSSB Admit Card / Call Letter.

  • Second Method : In this method, you will have to enter the application number of the online application you had applied, along with you will also have to enter your date of birth, after that you will be entered in a dashboard, then you will see a tab above, in that you will get the link of generate admit card, click on it. But your admit card will be downloaded on your mobile / computer.
  • If you do not have the application number then you have to follow the first method and find your application number.
  • You can print the admit card in color or black and white print on A4 size paper.
  • Read all the instructions given in the admit card carefully before going to the exam.

DSSSB How to View Question Paper and Download Answer Key and

  • You have to click on the link given below to view and download the answer key and question paper.

CTET Primary Level (Class I to V): Eligibility with Code September 2026
  1. Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and passed or appearing of 2- year Diploma in Elementary Education (by whatever name known) OR
  2. Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with at least 45% marks and passed or appearing in of 2- year Diploma in Elementary Education (by whatever name known), in accordance with the NCTE (Recognition Norms and Procedure), Regulations, 2002.  OR
  3. Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and passed or appearing in 4- year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed).
  4. Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and passed or appearing in 2- year Diploma in Education (Special Education).

CTET Junior Level (Class VI to VIII): Eligibility with Code September  2026
  1. Graduation and passed or appearing in final year of 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (by whatever name known).
  2. At least 50% marks either in Graduation or in Post-Graduation and passed or appearing in Bachelor in Education (B.Ed).
  3. Graduation with at least 45% marks and passed or appearing in Bachelor in Education (B.Ed), in accordance with the NCTE (Recognition Norms and Procedure) Regulations issued from time to time in this regard.
  4. Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and passed or appearing in of 4- year Bachelor in Elementary Education (B.El.Ed).
  5. Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and passed or appearing in of 4- year B.A/B.Sc.Ed or B.A.Ed/B.Sc.Ed.
  6. Graduation with at least 50% marks and passed or appearing in  B.Ed. (Special Education)*.
  7. Any candidate having qualified B.Ed. Programme recognized by the NCTE is eligible to appear in TET/CTET. Moreover, as per the existing TET guidelines circulated vide NCTE letter dated 11-02-2011, a person who is pursuing any of the teacher education courses (recognized by the NCTE or the RCI, as the case may be) specified in the NCTE Notification dated 23rd August 2010 is also qualified to appear in the TET/CTET.
  8. Post-Graduation with a minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade and passed or appearing in three-year integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed.

Selection Process

The recruitment process will consist of Physical Efficiency Test (PET), Physical Standards Test (PST), Computer Based Test (CBT), Trade/Skill Test, Document Verification (DV) and Medical Examination (DME/RME).

  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET): Qualifying in nature.
    • For Constable (Driver, Motor Mechanic Vehicle, Gardner, Painter, Carpenter, Brass Band, Pipe Band, Cobbler, Tailor & Bugler): Male – 5 Kms race in 24 minutes; Female – 1.6 Kms in 8.30 minutes.
    • For Constable (Cook/Water Carrier, Barber & Hair Dresser, Washer man & Washer women, Safai Karmachari): Male – 1.6 Kms in 10 minutes; Female – 1.6 Kms in 12 minutes.
    • For Pioneer Wing (Mason / Electrician): Male – 1.6 Kms in 09 minutes.
    • Pregnant women candidates will be declared temporarily unfit.
  • Physical Standards Test (PST): Height, Chest (for males only) & Weight (proportionate to height & age).
    • Height: Male – 170 Cms (minimum); Female – 157 Cms (minimum). Relaxations applicable for certain categories (ST, NE States, Gorkhas, etc.).
    • Chest (Male only): Un-expanded – 80 Cms, Minimum expansion – 05 Cms. Relaxations applicable.
    • Candidates failing PST will be eliminated.
  • Computer Based Test (CBT): 100 marks (100 MCQs), duration 02 hours.
    • General Intelligence & Reasoning – 25 Qs / 25 Marks
    • General Knowledge & General Awareness – 25 Qs / 25 Marks
    • Elementary Mathematics – 25 Qs / 25 Marks
    • English/Hindi – 25 Qs / 25 Marks
    • Negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer.
    • Qualifying marks: UR – 30%, EWS/OBC – 25%, SC/ST & others – 20%.
    • Marks will be normalized. Merit list prepared on CBT marks.
  • Trade/Skill Test: Qualifying in nature (50 marks, minimum 20 marks required). Practical assessment of the applied trade/post.
  • Document Verification (DV): Original documents (Matric certificate, Domicile/PRC, Trade certificates, Caste/EWS/ESM certificates, etc.) will be verified.
  • Detailed Medical Examination (DME) / Review Medical Examination (RME): As per Uniform Guidelines issued by MHA. Temporary unfitness allowed only for pregnancy. Final selection subject to medical fitness.
  • Final merit list prepared on the basis of marks obtained in CBT (subject to qualifying all stages). Separate merit lists for male/female and each State/UT (All India basis for Pioneer posts).

How to Apply

Application Mode: Online only through CRPF website. No other mode will be accepted.

Steps to Apply:

  1. Visit the official website www.rect.crpf.gov.in.

Candidates must register their candidature by filling the Google Form available on the official CDAC website below the respective post details, on or before 26-05-2026 by 17:00 hrs. After registering, candidates must download and fill the prescribed CDAC Application Form and One Page Write-Up (available on the website below the post details) and attach a latest passport size photograph. Hard copies of applications/documents are NOT to be sent to C-DAC; all communications will be via email only. Important Instructions for C-DAC Thiruvananthapuram Project Staff Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Only registered candidates will be allowed to attend the walk-in/online interview — registration via Google Form is mandatory.
  • Candidates must read the full notification and General Terms & Conditions carefully before registering.
  • All qualifications must be from AICTE/UGC approved institutions or recognized universities.
  • Academic/teaching/research work, non-profit organization experience, internships/project work as part of academic curriculum, part-time, daily wage, or visiting/guest faculty experience will NOT be counted as valid experience.
  • Experience will be counted only if supported by proper experience certificate from previous/current employers clearly mentioning duration, salary and designation.
  • C-DAC's decision on experience is final; work experience claimed without supporting documents will not be considered.
  • Salary mentioned is the starting minimum for the given experience range; candidates with more experience will receive additional increment as per C-DAC policy.
  • C-DAC internal candidates must have completed at least 2 years of service at C-DAC as on the notification date to be eligible.
  • Posts are purely on contract basis — no claim or right to regular/permanent appointment at C-DAC will be entertained.
  • Selected candidates may be deployed/transferred to any project location anywhere in India as per organizational requirement.
  • Government/PSU/Autonomous Body employees must produce NOC/Employment Certificate at the time of interview.
  • C-DAC has not authorized any agent/agency for recruitment activities; candidates should not engage with any such entities.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in/online interview.
  • Any attempt to promote candidature by any means will be treated as disqualification for selection.
  • Internal candidates finally selected will have to resign from current C-DAC service and join the selected post as a new employee.
  • Candidates are advised to visit www.cdac.in regularly for notices, corrigenda, and updates — no individual communication will be made.
  • C-DAC reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of posts, not fill any post, or cancel/restrict/extend the recruitment process at any time without prior notice.

IAF AFCAT 02/2026 - Type of Commission

Type Details
Permanent Commission (PC) – Men & Women Candidates joining as PC would continue to serve till the age of superannuation in their respective branches as per their rank.
SSC – Flying Branch (Men & Women) Engagement period for Flying Branch SSC officers is 14 years from the date of commissioning.
SSC – Ground Duty Technical & Non-Technical (Men & Women) Initial tenure for SSC officers in Ground Duty branches would be for a period of 10 years. An extension of 4 years may be granted subject to service requirements, availability of vacancies, willingness, suitability, and merit.
Grant of PC (at a later date) Considered subject to service requirements, availability of vacancies, willingness, suitability, merit, and as per prevailing policies on the subject.

Note: SSC officers are not entitled for grant of pension.

IAF AFCAT 02/2026 - Eligibility Criteria (Age)

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on 01 July 2027. All age calculations are done with reference to 01 July 2027.

Flying Branch (AFCAT Entry) 20 to 24 years as on 01 July 2027 (born between 02 July 2003 and 01 July 2007, both dates inclusive). Upper age limit for candidates holding valid and current Commercial Pilot Licence issued by DGCA (India) is relaxable up to 26 years (born between 02 July 2001 to 01 July 2007, both dates inclusive).
Ground Duty (Technical & Non-Technical) – AFCAT Entry and Ground Duty (Technical) – GATE Score Entry 20 to 26 years as on 01 July 2027 (born between 02 July 2001 and 01 July 2007, both dates inclusive).

IAF AFCAT 02/2026 - Educational Qualifications

Details on physical/medical standards, educational qualifications, and the full selection procedure are available in the detailed notification on the website. Candidates are advised to visit the official AFCAT website for branch-wise educational qualification requirements.

Flying Branch Graduation with Physics and Mathematics at 10+2 level, or BE/B.Tech degree. (Refer official notification for full details.)
Ground Duty (Technical) BE/B.Tech in relevant engineering disciplines. GATE Score Entry candidates must have valid GATE scores in specified disciplines. (Refer official notification for full details.)
Ground Duty (Non-Technical) Graduation in relevant discipline as per the sub-branch (Administration, Logistics, Accounts, Education, Meteorology, Weather Service). (Refer official notification for full details.)

IAF AFCAT 02/2026 - Pay, Allowances & Privileges

IAF Offers the following pay and benefits on commissioning as per 7th CPC:

Rank Pay as per Defence Matrix Level MSP (Military Service Pay)
Flying Officer Rs. 56,100 – 1,77,500/- 10 Rs. 15,500/-

Note: Flight Cadets shall receive a fixed stipend of Rs. 56,100/- per month during one year of training.

Allowances: On commissioning, allowances are applicable based on the branch/nature of posting including Flying Allowance, Transport Allowance, Technical Allowance, Test Pilot & Flight Test Engineer Allowance, Risk and Hardship Allowance, etc.

Privileges: Air Force Officers are entitled to furnished accommodation, comprehensive medical cover for self and dependents, Canteen, Officers' Mess, loans at subsidised rates, LTC, Leave (60 days annual and 20 days casual), subject to service exigencies.

Insurance: Mandatory Insurance Cover is applicable for IAF Officers through Air Force Group Insurance Society (AFGIS). Group Insurance for death while in service is Rs. 1.25 Crore (on contribution). Similarly, PC Officers retiring from service after rendering 20 or more years of service and SSC Officers who have completed 14 years of service are covered under Air Veterans Insurance Cover (AVIC) for Rs. 24 Lacs initially for 15 years, after retirement. The annual transfer for this is Rs. 12 Lacs till the age of 75 years.

The selection process for IAF AFCAT 02/2026 is merit-based. Candidates registering for AFCAT entry will have to pay the examination fee and appear for the AFCAT Online Test conducted at various centres. Details of conduct of exam, examination centres, and mode of payment are available in the notification.

Stage Process
Stage 1 AFCAT Online Examination / NCC Special Entry / GATE Score Screening
Stage 2 Air Force Selection Board (AFSB) Interview (including Psychological Test, Group Tests, and Interview) at various AFSB centres
Stage 3 Medical Examination at Air Force Central Medical Establishment (AFCME) / Institute of Aviation Medicine (IAM)
Stage 4 Final Merit List and Joining Instructions

Physical Conditioning: Candidates are advised to be physically fit when reporting for SSB. Aim to achieve an ability to run 01 mile (1.6 km) in 10 minutes, do 10 push-ups and 03 chin-ups. Prospective candidates are also advised to keep themselves in good physical condition by training at RFA which encompasses running, swimming, rope climbing, and other forms of physical training/conditioning. Mandatory tests are conducted during training.

Coal India Limited MT Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

NTPC Engineer Contracts & Materials Recruitment 2026: Get the latest NTPC Limited recruitment notification 2026 for 25 Engineer (Contracts & Materials) vacancies under NTPC Limited, A Govt. of India Enterprise. The online application process starts on 11th May 2026 and the last date to apply online is 25th May 2026. Find NTPC vacancies on the official website careers.ntpc.co.in. You can also get OnlyJobs of "Upcoming NTPC Engineer Recruitment 2026" notifications for freshers and experienced candidates. Also know the direct official link for NTPC Engineer (Contracts & Materials) Recruitment 2026 apply online from the NTPC career page.

FOLLOW US

NTPC Engineer (Contracts & Materials) Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

NTPC Limited has officially released Advertisement No. 06B/26 for recruitment to 25 posts of Engineer (Contracts & Materials) – E2/IDA Grade. The notification includes complete details on vacancies, eligibility, experience requirements, selection process, application fee, and document upload instructions. Candidates are strongly advised to go through the full text of the advertisement and agree to all the conditions given while applying. Any further addendum/corrigendum/updates will only be published on the NTPC website. The notification PDF is available on the official NTPC careers website.

  • Download NTPC Engineer (Contracts & Materials) Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF

NTPC Engineer (Contracts & Materials) Recruitment 2026 Overview

Organization Name NTPC Limited (A Govt. of India Enterprise)
Advertisement No. 06B/26
Post Name Engineer (Contracts & Materials)
Field Contracts & Materials
Total Vacancies 25
Grade / Pay Scale E2 / IDA (Rs. 50,000 – 1,60,000/-)
Upper Age Limit 32 Years
Application Mode Online only (via careers.ntpc.co.in or www.ntpc.co.in)
Selection Mode Multi-stage selection process (Application Shortlisting / Written Test / Personal Interview etc.)
Nationality Indian Nationals only
Official Website https://careers.ntpc.co.in / https://www.ntpc.co.in

NTPC Engineer Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

Event Date
Commencement of Online Application 11-05-2026
Last Date for Online Application Submission 25-05-2026

NTPC Engineer Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details

A total of 25 vacancies have been announced for the post of Engineer (Contracts & Materials). These are distributed across UR, EWS, OBC, SC, and ST categories. Reservation for PwBD candidates is as per Govt. Guidelines. The total number of projected vacancies indicated may increase/decrease as per organizational requirement at the discretion of NTPC management.

Discipline UR EWS OBC SC ST Total
Engineer (Contracts & Materials) 13 02 06 03 01 25

*Reservation for PwBD candidates as per Govt. Guidelines.

Identified type of disabilities for the post: a) B, LV  b) D, HH  c) OA, BA, OL, BL, OAL, CP, LC, Dw, AAV, MDy  d) SLD, MI, ASD  e) MD involving (a) to (d) above.

NTPC Engineer Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the last date of receipt of online applications (25-05-2026). Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. All qualifications should be full-time from Universities/Institutions recognized and approved in India. SC/ST/PwBD candidates with passing marks in the qualifying degree are also eligible to apply.

All computations of age, experience requirement, and qualification will be done with reference to the last date of receipt of online applications. The category once filled in the online application form cannot be changed and no benefit of other category will be admissible later.

Educational Qualification

Qualification Details
Minimum Degree (Mandatory) B.E. / B.Tech Degree in Electrical / Electrical & Electronics / Electronics / Mechanical / Production / Electronics & Control & Instrumentation / Instrumentation / Civil with at least 60% marks from a recognized University/Institution.
Added Advantage (Desirable) MBA/PGDBM in Materials Management / Supply Chain Management / Logistics & Supply Chain Management / Operations Management.

Experience Requirement

Experience Criteria Details
Minimum Post-Qualification Experience Minimum 4 years of post-qualification (BE/B.Tech) executive experience (including training period, if any) in the Power/Oil/Gas/Steel sector.
Mandatory Domain Experience Out of the 4 years total experience, minimum 2 years' experience should be in Contract/Purchase/Stores/Procurement or combination thereof.
Experience Relaxation for SC/ST For SC/ST candidates, if prescribed experience is 3 to 5 years, the experience will be relaxed by a maximum of one year.

NTPC Engineer Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

The upper age limit for the post is 32 years as on the last date of receipt of online applications. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as specified below. In no case shall the age exceed the relaxed limit applicable to the respective category. Age relaxation of 10 years for PwBD candidates is in addition to SC/ST/OBC relaxation, wherever applicable.

Category Age Limit / Relaxation
General / EWS (UR) Upper age limit: 32 years
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) Relaxation of 3 years (max 35 years)
SC / ST Relaxation of 5 years (max 37 years)
PwBD Candidates Relaxation of 10 years (as per Govt. guidelines)
Ex-Serviceman As per Govt. guidelines

NTPC Engineer Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

Candidates belonging to the General/EWS/OBC category are required to pay a non-refundable application fee of Rs. 500/-. SC/ST/PwBD category and female candidates need not pay the application fee. Fees once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances. Candidates are therefore requested to verify their eligibility criteria before paying the application fee.

Category Application Fee
General / EWS / OBC Candidates (Male) Rs. 500/- (Non-Refundable)
SC / ST / PwBD Candidates & Female Candidates (All Categories) NIL (No Fee)

Payment in Offline Mode: State Bank of India (SBI) has been authorized to collect the application fee in a specially opened account (A/C No. 30987919993) at CAG branch, New Delhi (Code: 09996), on behalf of NTPC. Candidates must approach the nearby SBI branch with a printout of the "pay-in-slip" available on the application portal.

Payment in Online Mode: Candidates may also pay the fee online through Net Banking / Debit Card / Credit Card. The online payment option will be available in the online application form.

NTPC Engineer Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for NTPC Engineer (Contracts & Materials) Recruitment 2026 may comprise of multiple stages at the management's discretion. Depending on the requirement, the management reserves the right to conduct a multi-stage selection process. Merely fulfilling the minimum eligibility criteria does not bestow on the candidate the right to be shortlisted/called for written test/interview or to be considered for the selection process.

Stage Process
Stage 1 Application Shortlisting / Screening (based on qualification/percentage of marks, no. of years of post-qualification experience, etc.)
Stage 2 Written / Computer-based Test (if applicable)
Stage 3 Personal Interview
Stage 4 (Post-selection) Medical Examination by NTPC Medical Board/Officer (decision is final and binding)

Note: The above stages may be used in combination or independently as per requirement. Posting shall be at any of the Stations/Projects/JVs/Subsidiaries of NTPC. All posts are transferable at the sole discretion of the Management.

How to Apply for NTPC Engineer Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only through the NTPC careers portal at https://careers.ntpc.co.in or through the careers section at www.ntpc.co.in. No other means/mode of application shall be accepted. Candidates are required to possess a valid email ID. NTPC will not be responsible for bouncing back any email sent to the candidates. After applying online, the candidate is required to download the application slip generated by the system with a unique application number. No document is required to be sent to NTPC by post.

Candidates should ensure that all documents are uploaded completely while applying — applications with incomplete/insufficient documents are liable to be rejected/not considered for further process. The applicant should ensure he/she fulfills the eligibility and other norms mentioned above, as on the specified dates, and that the particulars furnished are correct in all respects.

Documents to be Scanned and Uploaded at the Time of Online Application:

  • Class X passing certificate/Marksheet, PAN Card, and Aadhaar Card (for Name and DOB proof)
  • Degree certificate (Final/Provisional)
  • Consolidated Marksheet/Transcript/all semester marksheets clearly indicating aggregate % of marks in all semesters
  • Marks conversion formula from the University/Institute for conversion of marks in CGPA/CGPI/DGPA/CGI/CPI etc. into percentage (%)
  • Caste/Disability certificate as applicable (for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD/EWS candidates)
  • OBC-NCL certificate in central format for current financial year (FY 2026-27)
  • EWS candidates: current year Income & Asset certificate valid for FY 2026-27 based on income of FY 2025-26
  • Disability certificate in latest prescribed central Govt. format generated online through Swavalamban/UDID portal (clearly indicating type and percentage of disability)
  • All experience-related documents for each organization/company in chronological order — including Experience/Service certificate (as per NTPC prescribed sample format), Offer of Appointment/Appointment letter/Offer Letter + Confirmation/Absorption Letter/Order on completion of training, Joining Order/Letter, Role Assignment orders, Promotion orders, Transfer orders, Organization charts, 02 pay slips per every year for each organization, etc.
  • Form 16 of current/previous employer for last 03 financial years (for candidates working in private sector)
  • NOC (No Objection Certificate) from current employer (for candidates working in Govt./Public Sector Undertakings)

Apply Online at: https://careers.ntpc.co.in

Important Instructions for NTPC Engineer Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • All qualifications should be full-time from Universities/Institutions recognized and approved in India.
  • The category once filled in the online application form cannot be changed. Candidates must have the applicable year's valid EWS/OBC/SC/ST/Disability certificate from the Competent Authority in the latest prescribed format of Govt. of India.
  • Applications with incomplete/insufficient documents are liable to be rejected/not considered for further process.
  • No other mode of application other than Online will be accepted. No documents need to be sent by post.
  • Fees once paid will not be refunded. Verify eligibility before making payment.
  • Candidates currently working in Govt./Public Sector Undertakings must submit NOC from the current employer.
  • Candidates working in the private sector must submit Form 16 of current/previous employer for the last 03 financial years.
  • The management reserves the right to cancel/restrict/curtail/increase the number of vacancies, if need arises, without further notice and without assigning any reason.
  • Posting shall be at any of the Stations/Projects/JVs/Subsidiaries of NTPC. All posts are transferable at the sole discretion of Management.
  • Canvassing in any form shall disqualify the candidate.
  • Any proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute can be instituted only in Delhi. Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Delhi only shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • In case of any ambiguity/dispute arising on account of interpretation in versions other than English, the English version will prevail.
  • All decisions of NTPC management regarding eligibility, selection, and other matters are final and binding.

  5. Fill the application form: Enter personal details, educational qualifications, category (General/OBC/SC/ST/EWS), address, and other required information accurately.

  8. Submit and save confirmation: Review all details before final submission. After submitting, download the application printout / PDF confirmation with your registration number. Store it safely for admit card, exam, and future reference.

Sarkari Job (सरकारी नौकरी) refers to government employment in India — jobs offered by central government departments, state governments, public sector undertakings (PSUs), banks, railways, defence forces, and other government-funded organisations. These jobs offer permanent employment, fixed salary as per 7th Pay Commission, pension, medical benefits, and unmatched job security.

Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 – FAQ's

How to apply for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 online?

Visit your state's official WCD / ICDS portal (link provided in table above). Register with mobile & Aadhaar, fill the application form, upload documents (photo, 10th certificate, Aadhaar, domicile), and submit before the last date. Print the application acknowledgement slip after submission.

What is the eligibility for Anganwadi Worker 2026?

Candidates must have passed 10th or 12th standard from a recognized board. Age limit is 18–35 years (varies by state). Must be a permanent resident of the ward/village for which vacancy exists. Only female candidates are eligible for Worker and Helper posts.

What is the salary of Anganwadi Worker in 2026?

Anganwadi Worker receives a monthly honorarium of ₹10,000–₹20,000 depending on the state (Karnataka and TN are highest at ~₹14,000). Anganwadi Helper gets ₹5,000–₹7,000/month. The Central Government pays ₹4,500/month as base honorarium, and states add their own component on top.

Is there a written exam for Anganwadi jobs?

No, there is no written examination for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts. Selection is purely merit-based on academic qualification marks (10th / 12th percentage). For Supervisor / CDPO posts, a written exam or interview may be conducted depending on the state.

What is the age limit for Anganwadi Helper?

Age limit is 18 to 35 years as of 1st January 2026 in most states. SC/ST candidates get 5 years relaxation (maximum age 40). OBC candidates get 3 years relaxation (maximum age 38). PwD candidates get additional relaxation as per state rules.

What documents are required for Anganwadi job application?

Required documents: Aadhaar card, 10th/12th marksheet and certificate, domicile/residence certificate, caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC), passport-size photograph, scanned signature, and EWS/PwD certificate if applicable. Graduation certificate is needed for Supervisor post applications.

What is ICDS recruitment 2026?

ICDS stands for Integrated Child Development Services - the government programme under which Anganwadi centres operate nationwide. ICDS recruitment 2026 refers to hiring of Anganwadi Workers, Helpers, Supervisors, and CDPOs by state WCD departments under the Ministry of Women & Child Development (wcd.nic.in).

Is Anganwadi Worker a permanent government job?

Anganwadi Workers and Helpers are honorary workers, not regular government employees. They receive a fixed monthly honorarium (not salary) and are entitled to benefits like ESI, health insurance, and maternity benefits. Supervisors and CDPOs are regular government employees in most states and receive full pay & grade pay.

Can I apply for Anganwadi job from a different district?

No. Anganwadi Workers and Helpers must be permanent residents of the same ward/village/district where the vacancy exists. A domicile or residence certificate is mandatory. Applications from outside the specified locality are rejected. For Supervisor/CDPO posts, the same district residency rule generally applies.

Eligibility for Forest Department Jobs

Eligibility for forest department jobs depends on the post, state and recruitment authority. Below is a general idea of qualification and age for popular posts like Forest Guard, Forester and Forest Range Officer. Candidates should always check the official notification for detailed eligibility criteria.

Education Qualification for Forest Guard, Forester, Ranger

  • Forest Guard / Field Guard / Forest Watcher / Beat Guard: Usually 10th pass or 12th pass from a recognized board, knowledge of local language, and basic physical standards as per state rules.
  • Forester / Section Forest Officer / Deputy Forest Ranger: Generally 12th pass or graduate in any stream or science-related subjects, with physical standards and sometimes driving or technical skills depending on the post.
  • Forest Range Officer (RFO) / Forest Ranger / ACF: Normally graduate degree in Science, Agriculture, Forestry, Environmental Science, Engineering or related disciplines, with higher physical standards and sometimes a competitive exam similar to state PCS level.
  • IFS / Indian Forest Service and senior posts (DCF, CF, CCF, PCCF): Filled through UPSC Indian Forest Service Examination and promotions, requiring a graduate degree and all-India competitive selection.

Age Limit & Relaxation

  • Forest Guard / Forester / Field Guard: Minimum age is usually 18 years and maximum age is around 27–30 years, with age relaxation for SC, ST, OBC, EWS, Ex-servicemen and other categories as per government rules.
  • Forest Range Officer / ACF and higher competitive posts: Age limit often ranges from 21 to 32 years (varies by recruitment), with relaxations for reserved categories.
  • Exact age limit, cut-off date and relaxation details always depend on the particular notification, so candidates should verify from the official advertisement before applying.

Selection Process & Exam Pattern

The selection process for Forest Department Jobs 2026 typically includes written examinations, physical tests and document verification. Some posts also conduct medical examination and walking tests due to the demanding nature of field duties.

Written Exam, PET/PST & Document Verification

  • Written Exam: Most Forest Guard, Forester and Forest Range Officer recruitments start with a written exam based on objective-type questions (MCQs).
  • PET / PST (Physical Efficiency Test / Physical Standard Test): Candidates who qualify written exam are called for running, walking test, height, chest measurement and other physical parameters as per post and gender.
  • Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates must produce original certificates of age, qualification, caste, residence, sports/NCC and other documents mentioned in the notification.
  • Medical Examination: Many forest posts require medical fitness to ensure candidates can perform field duties in forests, wildlife areas and difficult terrain.

Syllabus Highlights for Forest Guard & Ranger

Typical syllabus for written exam may include:

  • General Knowledge & Current Affairs (national, state-level, environment and forest-related topics)
  • General Hindi / English or regional language (grammar, comprehension, vocabulary)
  • General Mathematics / Quantitative Aptitude (up to 10th or 12th level)
  • General Science and Environmental Studies (forest, wildlife, biodiversity, conservation, climate, basic biology)
  • Reasoning Ability (logical and analytical reasoning)

Exact subject-wise marks, number of questions, negative marking and exam duration will be given in the respective forest department notification.

How to Apply for Forest Department Jobs 2026

Most Forest Department Jobs 2026 applications are accepted either online through official websites or offline via prescribed application forms. Candidates should carefully read the official notification before filling the form.

Online Application Process

  1. Visit the official website of the recruiting body (State Forest Department, State PSC, Staff Selection Board or other government portal).
  2. Find the latest link for Forest Guard / Forester / Forest Range Officer / other forest posts and open the detailed advertisement.
  3. Complete the registration process with basic details like name, mobile number, email ID and verify using OTP if required.
  4. Fill the online application form with personal, educational, address and category information exactly as per documents.
  5. Upload scanned copies of photograph, signature and other certificates in the prescribed format and size.
  6. Pay the application fee online through Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card or UPI as per your convenience.
  7. Finally, submit the form and take a printout or PDF of the submitted application and payment receipt for future reference.

  • Recent passport size photograph and signature (scanned)
  • Class 10th and 12th mark sheets and certificates
  • Degree / Diploma certificates for graduate-level posts

  • Domicile / Residence certificate if required by the state
  • NCC, Sports, Ex-serviceman and other quota certificates if applicable
  • Valid ID proof (Aadhaar Card, PAN, Voter ID, Driving Licence, Passport, etc.)

Forest department jobs are popular among candidates who love nature, wildlife and field work. These jobs offer job security, government benefits and a chance to work in forest conservation, wildlife protection, eco-tourism and community development.

  • Stable government job with regular salary, pension/NPS and allowances
  • Opportunity to work in forests, wildlife sanctuaries, national parks and protected areas
  • Contribution to environment protection, afforestation and biodiversity conservation
  • Good promotion avenues from Forest Guard to Forester, Forest Range Officer and higher posts in many states.

Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) under Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India has published the detailed advertisement for recruitment of 404 Sportspersons as Constable (General Duty) under Sports Quota for the year 2026. Online applications are invited from eligible Male & Female candidates for filling up these Group 'C' Non-Gazetted, (Non-Ministerial) Combatised posts. The recruitment is temporary but likely to be continued. Candidates with outstanding sports achievements in various disciplines can apply online. The last date for submission of online applications will be 30 days from the date of publication of this advertisement in Employment News.

FOLLOW US

SSB Constable GD Sports Quota Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

Sashastra Seema Bal has released detailed recruitment notification File No.541/RC/SSB/CT(GD)SO-2025/2026 dated 2026 for engagement of 404 Constables (GD) under Sports Quota. The notification contains complete details regarding vacancies discipline-wise, eligibility criteria, age relaxation, sports achievements required, selection process, physical standards, medical examination and application procedure. All eligible sportspersons are advised to download and read the full official notification carefully before applying online through the SSB Recruitment Portal.

SSB Constable GD Sports Quota Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill the following eligibility conditions as on the last date of receipt of applications:

Educational Qualification: Matriculation or equivalent from a recognized Board or Institute.

Sports Qualification (Order of Preference):

  • Represented India in International competitions, OR
  • Medal winners in Senior/Junior National Championships, OR
  • Medal winners in Khelo India Youth/University/Winter/Para Games, OR
  • Medal winners in SGFI, OR
  • Represented University in Inter-University Tournaments, OR
  • Represented State School Teams in National School Games.

Note: Sports achievements of only last 02 years (as on cut-off date) will be considered.

Age Limit: 18 to 23 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

SSB Constable GD Sports Quota Selection Process

The selection will be conducted in Two Stages:

Stage-I (Priority Candidates - International & National Medal Winners upto 3rd Place):

  • Documentation
  • Checking of Sports Achievements (Marks based on medals/participation)
  • Physical Standard Test (PST)
  • Detailed Medical Examination (DME)
  • Review Medical Examination (RME) if required

Stage-II (Remaining candidates, if vacancies remain unfilled):

  • Documentation
  • Field Trial / Skill Test (50 marks, minimum 60% qualifying)
  • Physical Standard Test (PST)
  • Detailed Medical Examination (DME)
  • Review Medical Examination (RME)

Physical Standard Test (PST) Requirements:

Category Male Height Female Height Male Chest (Un-expanded / Expanded)
General 170 cm 157 cm 80-85 cm
Relaxed Categories (as per notification) 157 cm to 165 cm 147.5 cm to 155 cm As per rules

Weight: BMI should be between 18-25.

Final Merit: Based on Sports Achievement marks + Field Trial (where applicable) + Medical Fitness.

How to Apply for SSB Constable GD Sports Quota 2026

Applications must be submitted online only through the official SSB Recruitment website www.recruitment.ssb.gov.in. Candidates should follow the instructions carefully while filling Part-I (Details), Part-II (Photo, Signature & Documents upload) and Part-III (Payment).

Documents to be Uploaded:

  • Recent passport size photograph & signature
  • Matriculation certificate
  • Sports achievement certificates (in prescribed formats)
  • Caste / Category certificate (if applicable)
  • Age relaxation certificates
  • Aadhaar / Photo ID proof

Apply Link for SSB Constable GD Sports Quota 2026

Important Instructions for SSB Constable GD Sports Quota Candidates

  • Only Indian citizens (or subjects of Nepal/Bhutan with permission) are eligible.
  • Candidates must bring all original documents at the time of documentation.
  • Persons already in Government service must apply through proper channel and submit NOC at documentation stage.

Indian Army HQ 2 Signal Training Centre, Panaji, Goa has released the official Civilian Switch Board Operator (CSBO) Grade-II, Group 'C' Notification 2026 on 02 May 2026 at the official website indianarmy.nic.in. A total of 190 vacancies have been announced under the CSBO Grade-II Recruitment 2026. Eligible candidates aged between 18 and 25 years with a qualification of Matriculation (10th) and minimum 6 months experience in handling Private Board Exchange (PBX) Board can apply via email from 02 May 2026 to 31 May 2026. The official notification PDF and email application instructions are available below.

FOLLOW US

Indian Army CSBO Grade-II Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

The Headquarters 2 Signal Training Centre, Panaji, Goa (Indian Army / Ministry of Defence, Government of India) has officially released the Employment Notice for recruitment to 190 posts of Civilian Switch Board Operator (CSBO) Grade-II, Group 'C' on probation for a period of two years followed by permanent absorption subject to satisfactory performance. The notification includes complete details on vacancies, eligibility, age criteria, selection process, examination scheme, reservation norms, and application instructions. Candidates are strongly advised to download and read the full notification before applying. The notification PDF is available on the official Indian Army recruitment page.

  • Download Indian Army CSBO Grade-II Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF

Indian Army CSBO Grade-II Recruitment 2026 Overview

Organisation Name HQ 2 Signal Training Centre, Panaji, Goa - Indian Army, Ministry of Defence, Govt. of India
Employment Notice No. Advt_020526 dated 02/05/2026
Post Name Civilian Switch Board Operator (CSBO) Grade-II, Group 'C'
Department Ministry of Defence, Government of India
Service Liability All India Service Liability including Field Service
Total Vacancies 190 (including 12 PwBD posts and 20 ESM posts - Horizontal Reservation)
Pay Scale Rs. 21,700/- + allowances (Level-3, Cell-1 as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix)
Application Mode Online only - via official email ID: [email protected] (PDF application form submitted as email attachment)
Selection Mode Written Test (100 marks) + Practical Test (Qualifying) + Interview (Qualifying) + Medical Test
Mandatory Requirement Minimum 6 months experience in handling Private Board Exchange (PBX) Board - Experience Certificate mandatory
Official Email [email protected]

Indian Army CSBO Grade-II Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

Event Date & Time

Indian Army CSBO Grade-II Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details

A total of 190 vacancies have been announced for the post of Civilian Switch Board Operator (CSBO) Grade-II, Group 'C'. These are distributed across UR, SC, ST, OBC, and EWS categories as vertical reservation. Additionally, 12 posts are horizontally reserved for PwBD candidates and 20 posts are horizontally reserved for Ex-Servicemen (ESM) as per DoPT OM No. 36035/02/2017/Estt (Res) dated 15 Jan 2018.

Post Name Total Posts PwBD (Horizontal) ESM (Horizontal)
CSBO Grade-II 190 12 20

Indian Army CSBO Grade-II Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the closing date of application (31-05-2026). Only citizens of India are eligible to apply. Proficiency in handling Private Board Exchange (PBX) Board with a minimum experience of 6 months is a crucial and mandatory criterion - no application will be accepted without a valid Experience Certificate in handling PBX Board. The post is subject to All India Service Liability including Field Service.

Educational Qualification

Qualification Type Details
Essential Qualification (i) Matric or equivalent from a recognized Board
Essential Qualification (ii) Proficiency in handling Private Board Exchange (PBX) Board with minimum 6 months experience (Experience Certificate mandatory)
Desirable Fluency in spoken English and Hindi

Indian Army CSBO Grade-II Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

Candidates must be between 18 and 25 years of age as on the last date of receipt of application (31-05-2026). Age relaxations are available for reserved categories and special groups as specified below. The crucial date for determining the age limit shall be the last date of receipt of application. No extra weightage will be given for additional/extra/higher qualifications for recruitment.

Category Age Limit / Relaxation
General (UR) / EWS 18 to 25 years (as on 31-05-2026)
OBC 3 years relaxation (max 28 years)
SC / ST 5 years relaxation (max 30 years)
PwBD (UR/EWS) 10 years relaxation (max 35 years)
PwBD (OBC) 13 years relaxation (10 + 3 years)
PwBD (SC/ST) 15 years relaxation (10 + 5 years)
Ex-Servicemen Additional 3 years relaxation (over and above actual military service rendered)
Departmental Candidates (with 3 years continuous service) Up to 40 years (45 years for SC/ST candidates)

Indian Army CSBO Grade-II Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

The official notification does not specify any application fee for Indian Army CSBO Grade-II Recruitment 2026. No fee details have been mentioned in the Employment Notice. Candidates are advised to check the official notification carefully and contact the official email ID [email protected] for any fee-related clarifications. No TA/DA is admissible for appearing in Written Test, Practical Test, and Interview - candidates must make their own arrangements for boarding/lodging at 2 STC, Goa.

Indian Army CSBO Grade-II Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for Indian Army CSBO Grade-II Recruitment 2026 consists of 3 stages - Written Test (100 marks, merit-based), Practical Test (qualifying only), and Interview (qualifying only), followed by a Medical Test for shortlisted candidates. Selection will be made strictly on the basis of merit in the Written Test, subject to the candidate qualifying in the Practical Test and Interview. To reduce the number of candidates for the Written Examination, screening of applications may be carried out based on percentage of marks obtained in Matriculation/10th Board examination.

Stage 1 - Written Test (100 Marks - Merit Based)

Part Subject Type Marks
Part-I General Intelligence & Numerical Aptitude Objective Multiple Choice Type 25
Part-II General Awareness Objective Multiple Choice Type 25
Part-III General English Objective Multiple Choice Type 25
Part-IV Logic & Reasoning Objective Multiple Choice Type 25
Total 100

The question paper will be bilingual (English and Hindi). However, questions of General English subject will be in English only. No extra weightage will be given for additional/extra/higher qualifications.

Stage 2 - Practical Test and Interview (Qualifying Only)

Practical Test To check candidate's proficiency in handling exchange operation - Qualifying in nature only (marks not counted for merit)
Interview Conducted along with Practical Test for qualifying purpose only - marks not counted for final merit

Stage 3 - Medical Test

Medical Test Only shortlisted candidates based on performance in Written Test, Practical Test, and Interview will be directed to undergo Medical Test as per extant Government Orders

Terms of Engagement

Probation Period 2 years probation followed by permanent absorption subject to satisfactory performance
Pension New entrants joining on or after 01 Jan 2004 are governed by the National Pension System
Retention Beyond 55 Years / 30 Years of Service Subject to screening committee approval; retirement from service on attaining age of 60 years if retained
Disqualification Candidate will be disqualified if found to have contracted a marriage while having a living spouse, or entered into another marriage

Indian Army CSBO Grade-II Recruitment 2026 - Exam Syllabus

The Written Test consists of 4 parts - General Intelligence & Numerical Aptitude, General Awareness, General English, and Logic & Reasoning - each carrying 25 marks (total 100 marks), all Objective Multiple Choice Type. The question paper is bilingual (English and Hindi) except the General English section which is in English only. After the Written Test, shortlisted candidates undergo a Practical Test and Interview (both qualifying in nature) to assess proficiency in handling exchange/PBX Board operations.

Part Topic Marks
Part-I General Intelligence & Numerical Aptitude 25
Part-II General Awareness 25
Part-III General English 25
Part-IV Logic & Reasoning 25

How to Apply for Indian Army CSBO Grade-II Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only through the official email ID [email protected]. Hard copy applications sent by post will not be accepted. The application window is open from 02-05-2026 (0001 Hrs) to 31-05-2026 (2359 Hrs). Candidates must open the PDF application form in Adobe Acrobat Reader ONLY - do NOT open in browser (Chrome/Edge) as fields may not work. All fields marked with * are mandatory and must not be left blank. All text must be typed in BLOCK LETTERS (CAPITALS).

Candidates should not send their application more than once. Incomplete or wrongly named applications will be rejected without notice. Applications with missing attachments, unsigned forms, or mismatched information will be summarily rejected. Candidates must carry originals of all documents for verification while appearing for examination along with two additional self-attested photographs. For difficulties in filling the application form, candidates may send a screenshot of the issue to [email protected].

Documents to be Submitted Along with Application (as self-attested attachments to email):

  • Birth Certificate (Matriculation Certificate/Mark Sheet can be produced in lieu)
  • Educational Certificate - Matriculation Passing Certificate and Mark Sheet
  • Experience Certificate in handling PBX/EPABX Board (minimum 6 months duration - mandatory)
  • Residential Certificate
  • Domicile Certificate
  • Aadhaar Card (mandatory); PAN Card (optional)
  • Caste/Category Certificate in prescribed format (for all reserved categories - SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD)
  • Discharge Certificate (mandatory for Ex-Servicemen candidates, in addition to category certificate)
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC) from present employer (if already a Government servant)
  • Passport size photograph (JPG file - latest, not older than 3 months; saved as PHOTO_YourFullName.jpg)
  • Signed application form saved as CSBO_YourFullName.pdf

Applications must be emailed to: [email protected] with the subject line: CSBO Application – YOUR FULL NAME

Applications must be addressed to: The Commandant, Headquarters, 2 Signal Training Centre, Panaji (Goa) – 403001

Official Email for Application: [email protected]

Last Date for Email Submission: 31 May 2026 (2359 Hrs)

Important Instructions for Indian Army CSBO Grade-II Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Only citizens of India are eligible to apply; the post is subject to All India Service Liability including Field Service.
  • PBX Board handling experience of minimum 6 months is mandatory - no application will be accepted without the Experience Certificate.
  • No hard copy applications will be accepted - submission via official email only ([email protected]).
  • No application fee is required; no TA/DA is admissible for Written Test, Practical Test, and Interview.
  • Do not send your application more than once - incomplete or wrongly named applications will be rejected without notice.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be intimated via call letters sent to their registered email ID only - department not responsible for non-receipt of call letters.
  • Screening of applications may be done based on Matriculation/10th Board marks percentage to reduce the number of candidates for Written Examination.
  • Merely fulfilling the basic selection criteria does not automatically entitle a person to be called for test/interview.
  • Persons working in Central/State Govt/PSU must apply through proper channel with NOC from their establishment.
  • Ex-Servicemen candidates must enclose self-attested photocopy of complete discharge book along with the undertaking format provided with the application.
  • EWS candidates must provide income/asset certificate from the competent authority.
  • Candidates must carry originals of all documents for verification while appearing for examination along with two additional self-attested photographs.
  • Falsification of documents at any stage will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • Attempts to influence the selection process or use of unfair means (forgery, impersonation, false information) may lead to termination of candidature or legal action.
  • The Appointing Authority has the right to cancel/postpone/suspend/terminate/modify the notification without prior notice at any stage.
  • Recruitment Board's decision will be final in all matters.

Candidates must fulfill the essential educational qualifications and experience as mentioned against each post. Detailed qualifications are available in the official notification. Qualifications are relaxable at the discretion of UPSC for otherwise well-qualified candidates.

  • Engineering Faculty Posts require B.E./B.Tech + M.E./M.Tech with first class in relevant discipline.
  • Translator Posts require Bachelor’s Degree in the concerned foreign language or equivalent diploma with English.
  • Administrative & Other Posts require Bachelor’s Degree with relevant experience.
  • PwBD candidates must meet the specified disability criteria.

  • For SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates: NIL

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • Selection will be made on the basis of: - Shortlisting based on essential/desirable qualifications and experience. - Recruitment Test (if conducted). - Personal Interview.
  • Final merit list will be prepared after the interview. Minimum qualifying marks apply for each category.

How to Apply for UPSC Advertisement No. 04/2026

Candidates must apply online only using the UPSC ORA portal: https://upsconline.nic.in/ora/. - First register/create profile (URN). - Fill Common Application Form (CAF). - Fill post-specific module. - Upload required documents, photograph, and signature. - Pay fee (if applicable) and submit.

Documents to be Uploaded:

  • Educational certificates, experience certificates, caste/PwBD certificates, etc. in PDF format.

Prerequisites Before Starting the Application

Before logging into the portal, ensure you have the following ready:

  1. Valid Email ID and Mobile Number – These will be used for all future communication and OTP verification.
  2. Scanned Documents (in PDF format, preferably under 1 MB each):
    • Recent passport-size photograph
    • Signature
    • Matriculation/10th certificate (for Date of Birth proof)
    • All educational qualification certificates and mark sheets
    • Experience certificates (if applicable)
    • Caste/Category certificate (OBC/EWS/SC/ST)
    • PwBD certificate (if applicable)
    • Any other supporting documents mentioned in the notification
  3. Details of all educational qualifications and experience chronologically.
  4. Credit/Debit Card or Net Banking details for payment of application fee (if applicable).
  5. Aadhaar Number (recommended for easier registration).

Important Instructions for UPSC Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Applications received after the closing date or incomplete in any respect will be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates must upload clear scanned copies of all supporting documents.
  • Date of birth mentioned in Matriculation certificate will be considered final.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview and must bring original documents.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature.
  • UPSC reserves the right to cancel/withdraw any post without assigning any reason.

PwBD (UR) 10 years relaxation
PwBD (OBC) 13 years relaxation
PwBD (SC/ST) 15 years relaxation
Ex-Servicemen (ESM) 3 years after deduction of military service from actual age as on 01.08.2026

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Application Fee

The application fee for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 is ₹100 for General (UR), OBC, and EWS male candidates. Women candidates and candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), and Ex-Servicemen eligible for reservation are fully exempted from payment of fee.

Fee can be paid online only through BHIM UPI, Net Banking, or by using Visa, MasterCard, Maestro, or RuPay Debit Card. The fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances and will not be adjusted against any other examination. Candidates must ensure their fee payment is complete - if the fee is not received by SSC, the application status will show as "Incomplete" and will be summarily rejected.

General / OBC / EWS (Male) ₹100/-
Women / SC / ST / PwBD / Ex-Servicemen NIL (Exempted)

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Scheme of Examination

The SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 will consist of two papers. Paper-I is a Computer Based Examination with objective-type multiple choice questions, divided into two sections - General Hindi and General English - each carrying 100 marks with a sectional timer of 1 hour. There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in Paper-I.

Based on performance in Paper-I, candidates will be shortlisted category-wise to appear in Paper-II, which is a descriptive paper testing translation and essay writing skills in both Hindi and English, carrying 200 marks. Marks scored in Paper-I will be normalized if the exam is held in multiple shifts. Tentative Answer Keys will be uploaded after the exam, and candidates can submit online representations within the given time on payment of ₹50 per question (non-refundable).

Paper Mode Subject Questions / Marks Duration
Paper-I (Objective) Computer Based Part-I: General Hindi
Part-II: General English		 100/100
100/100		 2 Hours (Sectional timer: 1 hr each part)
{2 hrs 40 min for scribe-eligible candidates}
Paper-II (Descriptive) Pen & Paper Translation (Hindi ↔ English) & Essay 200 Marks 2 Hours

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Selection Process

The selection process for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 consists of two stages. In the first stage, Paper-I (Computer Based Examination) is used to shortlist candidates category-wise for Paper-II. Minimum qualifying marks in Paper-I are 30% for UR, 25% for OBC/EWS, and 20% for all other categories. In the second stage, Paper-II (Descriptive) is conducted for shortlisted candidates.

For the final merit list, 50% weightage is given to Paper-I scores and 100% weightage to Paper-II marks. Final selection and allocation of Ministry/Department/Organization is based on merit-cum-preference of posts/departments exercised by candidates through an Online Option Form. In case of a tie, it is resolved by total marks in Paper-II, then date of birth (older preferred), and finally alphabetical order of names. Selected candidates will be on probation for 2 years and all posts carry All India Service Liability (AISL).

Stage Details
1. Paper-I (CBE) Objective type; used for shortlisting category-wise candidates for Paper-II. Minimum qualifying marks: UR 30%, OBC/EWS 25%, Others 20%
2. Paper-II (Descriptive) Translation passages (Hindi ↔ English) and Essay; 200 marks; qualifying based on Paper-I merit
3. Final Merit 50% weightage of Paper-I + 100% weightage of Paper-II marks
4. Post Preference & Allocation Online Option Form to be submitted before FRTA; merit-cum-preference based allocation
5. Document Verification Conducted by User Departments/Organizations after declaration of final result

Tie-Breaking Order

1st Higher total marks in Paper-II
2nd Date of Birth - older candidate preferred
3rd Alphabetical order of names of candidates

How to Apply for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026

The application process for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 is entirely online at https://ssc.gov.in. Candidates who have not yet completed their One-Time Registration (OTR) on the new SSC website must do so first, as the earlier OTR from the old website (ssc.nic.in) is not valid for the new portal. Aadhaar-based biometric authentication is available and recommended - candidates who opt for it will not face rejection on grounds of photograph or signature quality.

The application module is designed to capture a live photograph of the candidate through webcam or mobile device; pre-existing photographs must not be submitted. Candidates must also upload their scanned signature in JPEG/JPG format (10-20 KB). Applications with blurred or miniature photographs or signatures will be summarily rejected unless Aadhaar authentication has been opted for. Only one online application per candidate is permitted during the normal application period.

  • Visit the official website https://ssc.gov.in and complete One-Time Registration (OTR).
  • Login using Registration Number and Password.
  • Click on "Apply" under "Combined Hindi Translators Examination, 2026" in the Live Exam tab.
  • Fill in educational details, additional information (ESM/age relaxation), and examination centre preferences (up to 3 centres).
  • Capture live photograph through webcam/mobile as per instructions (no cap, mask, or spectacles).
  • Upload scanned signature in JPEG/JPG format (10-20 KB), dimensions ~6.0 cm (W) × 2.0 cm (H).
  • PwBD/PwD candidates must upload Disability Certificate as per Annexure-I/IA/X/XI, whichever is applicable.
  • Preview the application carefully, complete the declaration, and submit before 14.05.2026 (23:00 hours).
  • Pay the application fee (if applicable) online through BHIM UPI, Net Banking, or Debit Card on or before 15.05.2026 (23:00 hours).
  • Take a printout of the submitted application for future reference.

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Application Form

Eligible candidates who wish to apply for the SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 can do so by submitting their application form online only. The application process is entirely online, and candidates must ensure they complete all steps including OTR, form filling, photograph/signature upload, and fee payment before the respective closing dates.

The application form is accessible through the official SSC website after completing One-Time Registration. Candidates are strongly advised to fill the application carefully as only one application is accepted per candidate - multiple applications will lead to cancellation of candidature. Details such as name, father's name, mother's name, and date of birth must be filled exactly as they appear in the Matriculation Certificate. After final submission, modifications are only permitted during the correction window (19.05.2026 to 20.05.2026) on payment of correction charges.

Apply Online at: https://ssc.gov.in

Candidates applying for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 must read the official notification carefully in its entirety before filling and submitting the application form. The English version of the notice will prevail in case of any dispute. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the closing date to avoid last-minute server load issues on the SSC website. All candidatures are provisional - the Commission does not undertake detailed scrutiny at the time of the written examination, and eligibility will be verified only at the Document Verification stage by the User Departments. Any suppression or misrepresentation of information in the application can lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage, including after selection. Canvassing in any form will result in immediate disqualification. The decision of the Commission in all matters including eligibility, selection, and allocation of posts is final and binding.

  • All posts carry All India Service Liability (AISL) - candidates may be posted anywhere in India.

The candidate must qualify separately in both the online written test and interview. The mere fact that a candidate is fulfilling the minimum eligibility criteria would not bestow on them the right to be shortlisted/called for written test/Interview.

Stage 2 – Online Written Test Two parts: (i) Subject Knowledge Test (SKT); (ii) Executive Aptitude Test (EAT). Candidates must qualify in both sections separately. Weightage: 85% of written test marks (if interview is also conducted).

Experience certificates must be issued by the concerned Inspector of Society and countersigned by the Assistant Registrar, Cooperative Societies of H.P. with authentic certification. Such certificate must be supported by: (i) Copy of resolution of the managing committee for initial appointment, and (ii) Copy of relevant pages of statutory audit report/note for prescribed years showing payment of wages/salary from the society account.

Educational Qualification

Post / Quota Essential Qualifications
Junior Clerk (PACS Quota - Trained Secretaries of PACS of HP) (i) Graduate in any discipline from a recognized University (Candidates must have passed Matriculation and 10+2 from a School/Institution within Himachal Pradesh - not applicable for Bonafide Himachalis); (ii) Minimum 3 years continuous service as Secretary as defined in Rule 2(vii) of H.P. Cooperative Societies Rules, 1971 of Primary Agriculture Credit Society; (iii) All employees of PACS covered under definition of "Trained Secretaries" are eligible; (iv) Candidate should not be a defaulter of his/her society
Junior Clerk (OCS Quota - Employees of Other Cooperative Societies and PACS employees not covered as Trained Secretaries) (i) Graduate in any discipline from a recognized University (Matriculation and 10+2 from HP school - not applicable for Bonafide Himachalis); (ii) Minimum 5 years continuous service in a cooperative society; (iii) All employees of other cooperative societies and PACS employees not covered under definition of "Trained Secretaries" are eligible; (iv) Candidate should not be a defaulter of his/her society

Types of PACS and OCS covered under this recruitment:

Quota Type Societies Covered
PACS (Primary Agricultural Credit Societies) Cooperative Multipurpose Societies Ltd.; Gram Service Cooperative Societies Ltd.
OCS (Other Cooperative Societies) Fruit Growers and Marketing Society Ltd.; Marketing and Consumer Cooperative Societies Ltd.; Cooperative Consumer Store; Thrift & Credit Society Ltd.; All other Cooperative Societies registered under HP Cooperative Societies Act, 1968

HPSCB Junior Clerk Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

Candidates must be above 18 years and below 45 years of age as on 01-01-2026. Candidates born between 02-01-1981 and 01-01-2008 (both days inclusive) are eligible. Age relaxation is applicable only to Bonafide Himachali candidates of the respective reserved categories. Selected PwBD candidates will have to submit a Medical Certificate from a competent authority confirming physical fitness to perform duties.

Category Age Relaxation
General (UR) 18 to 45 years (as on 01-01-2026)
SC of HP 5 years relaxation (max 50 years)
ST of HP 5 years relaxation (max 50 years)
OBC of HP 5 years relaxation (max 50 years)
EWS of HP As per HP Govt. norms
Physically Handicapped (PwBD) 5 years relaxation (minimum 40% disability required)
Ward of Freedom Fighter (WFF) of HP 5 years relaxation
Ex-Servicemen (Reserved Vacancies) Age at time of joining military service should not exceed upper age limit; present age must be less than 58 years (Maximum relaxation: 12 years)
Ex-Servicemen (Unreserved Vacancies) Actual age minus approved military service must not exceed prescribed maximum age by more than 3 years (Maximum relaxation: 12 years)

HPSCB Junior Clerk Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

Candidates applying for the post of Junior Clerk are required to pay a non-refundable application fee as specified below. The fee must be paid online through the HPSCB application portal. Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances. Bank transaction charges for online payment will have to be borne by the candidate.

Category Application Fee
General (UR) and OBC of H.P. Rs. 1,000/- (Rupees One Thousand only) - Non-refundable
EWS of H.P. (Economically Weaker Sections) Rs. 800/- (Rupees Eight Hundred only) - Non-refundable
SC / ST / IRDP / BPL / ANTODAYA of HP Rs. 800/- (Rupees Eight Hundred only) - Non-refundable
Female Candidates of All Categories of HP Rs. 800/- (Rupees Eight Hundred only) - Non-refundable

HPSCB Junior Clerk Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for HPSCB Junior Clerk Recruitment 2026 consists of 2 stages - Online Examination (150 marks, 150 minutes, conducted through IBPS Mumbai) followed by Document Verification/Scrutiny. There is no personal interview. Candidates up to 1.75 times of vacant posts will be called for document verification. Final selection will be made strictly on the basis of merit in the online examination after document verification. Candidates must score minimum 40% marks in the online examination to be shortlisted for document verification. Candidates declared successful who do not personally attend document verification will have their candidature cancelled.

Stage 1 - Online Examination (150 Marks, 150 Minutes)

Sl. No. Subject No. of Questions Marks Duration
1 Reasoning 30 30 150 Minutes (2½ Hours) - No separate time limit per section
2 Numerical Ability 30 30
3 English 30 30
4 General Awareness (including HP General Knowledge) 30 30
5 H.P. Cooperative Societies Act and H.P. Cooperative Societies Rules 30 30
Total 150 150  

Stage 2 - Document Verification / Scrutiny

Shortlisting Ratio Candidates up to 1.75 times of vacant posts will be called for document verification
Minimum Qualifying Marks 40% of total marks (i.e., minimum 60 out of 150) in online examination
No Negative Marking There is NO negative marking in the online examination
Question Paper Type Objective type multiple choice (MCQ) - bilingual (English and Hindi)

Tie-Breaking Rules

1st Tie-Break Preference to candidates possessing higher academic qualifications
2nd Tie-Break Preference to candidates belonging to the State of H.P.

HPSCB Junior Clerk Recruitment 2026 - Exam Syllabus

The Online Examination consists of 5 sections - Reasoning, Numerical Ability, English, General Awareness, and H.P. Cooperative Societies Act and Rules - each carrying 30 marks (total 150 marks, 150 minutes). The level of examination and syllabus is in accordance with the minimum educational qualification criteria i.e. Graduation level. The question paper is bilingual (English and Hindi) and is of objective type MCQ. There is no negative marking. Preference will be given to candidates possessing knowledge of customs, traditions, languages, and culture of Himachal Pradesh and the test shall include questions on such subjects.

Section Topic Key Coverage Marks
Section 1 Reasoning Logical Reasoning, Analytical Reasoning, Verbal and Non-Verbal Reasoning 30
Section 2 Numerical Ability Quantitative Aptitude, Number Systems, Arithmetic, Data Interpretation 30
Section 3 English Reading Comprehension, Grammar, Vocabulary, Sentence Completion 30
Section 4 General Awareness (including HP GK) General Awareness, Current Affairs, HP General Knowledge, Customs, Traditions, Languages and Culture of Himachal Pradesh 30
Section 5 H.P. Cooperative Societies Act & H.P. Cooperative Societies Rules Provisions of HP Cooperative Societies Act and HP Cooperative Societies Rules 30

How to Apply for HPSCB Junior Clerk Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only through the Bank's website www.hpscb.bank.in by clicking the "APPLY ONLINE" option. Hard copy applications or applications by any other mode will not be accepted. The online application window is open from 09-05-2026 to 29-05-2026. Candidates must register on the portal, make fee payment online, and upload all required documents. No change will be possible after clicking the "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" button. Candidates are advised to keep their valid personal email ID and mobile number active till the completion of the entire recruitment process.

Before applying, candidates must have ready: scanned photograph (4.5 cm × 3.5 cm), signature (with black ink on white paper), left thumb impression (on white paper with black or blue ink), and a hand-written declaration in English on white paper with black ink. Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS will NOT be accepted. The hand-written declaration text is: "I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."

Documents Required to be Produced at Document Verification (when called):
